LanguageData.LP_Imp_InfusedArm.label: infused arm
LanguageData.LP_Imp_InfusedArm.description: A prosthetic arm forged from steel and a little mithril, then infused with magic. Replaces a whole arm, part efficiency 115%. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_Imp_InfusedLeg.label: infused leg
LanguageData.LP_Imp_InfusedLeg.description: A prosthetic leg forged from steel and a little mithril, then infused with magic. Replaces a whole leg, part efficiency 115%. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_Imp_ColdIronArm.label: cold iron arm
LanguageData.LP_Imp_ColdIronArm.description: A prosthetic arm forged from tempered cold iron, always cold to the touch. Replaces a whole arm, part efficiency 125%; +30% melee damage against targets weak to cold iron (fey blood, elves, psycasters) and fiends. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_Imp_MithralLeg.label: mithril leg
LanguageData.LP_Imp_MithralLeg.description: A mithril prosthetic leg so light it's almost weightless. Replaces a whole leg, part efficiency 130%; move speed penalties from worn apparel halved (most noticeable with heavy armor). Rare tier, takes 1 attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_Imp_AdamantArm.label: adamantine arm
LanguageData.LP_Imp_AdamantArm.description: A prosthetic arm forged from adamantine, almost unbreakable. Replaces a whole arm, part efficiency 140%; injuries on this arm -50%, melee armor penetration +25%. Rare tier, takes 1 attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_Imp_ClockEye.label: precision clockwork eye
LanguageData.LP_Imp_ClockEye.description: A clockwork eye of mithril gears and jade lenses. Replaces one eye, part efficiency 125%; shooting accuracy +5%, no penalty in dim light. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_Imp_MithralHeart.label: mithril heart core
LanguageData.LP_Imp_MithralHeart.description: A heart core of mithril and adamantine that beats steady and strong. Replaces the heart, part efficiency 130%; toxic buildup -50%, never gets heart disease again. Rare tier, takes 1 attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Str.label: ioun skull stone: strength
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Str.description: The ioun stones that orbit the head in the original game are set into the frontal bone here. Adventurer Strength +2 (applied after the ability cap, can exceed 20). Each takes 1 attunement slot, up to 3 set in the frontal bone; removal returns the stone.
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Dex.label: ioun skull stone: agility
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Dex.description: The ioun stones that orbit the head in the original game are set into the frontal bone here. Adventurer Dexterity +2 (applied after the ability cap, can exceed 20). Each takes 1 attunement slot, up to 3 set in the frontal bone; removal returns the stone.
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Con.label: ioun skull stone: fortitude
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Con.description: The ioun stones that orbit the head in the original game are set into the frontal bone here. Adventurer Constitution +2 (applied after the ability cap, can exceed 20). Each takes 1 attunement slot, up to 3 set in the frontal bone; removal returns the stone.
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Int.label: ioun skull stone: intellect
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Int.description: The ioun stones that orbit the head in the original game are set into the frontal bone here. Adventurer Intelligence +2 (applied after the ability cap, can exceed 20). Each takes 1 attunement slot, up to 3 set in the frontal bone; removal returns the stone.
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Wis.label: ioun skull stone: insight
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Wis.description: The ioun stones that orbit the head in the original game are set into the frontal bone here. Adventurer Wisdom +2 (applied after the ability cap, can exceed 20). Each takes 1 attunement slot, up to 3 set in the frontal bone; removal returns the stone.
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Cha.label: ioun skull stone: leadership
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Cha.description: The ioun stones that orbit the head in the original game are set into the frontal bone here. Adventurer Charisma +2 (applied after the ability cap, can exceed 20). Each takes 1 attunement slot, up to 3 set in the frontal bone; removal returns the stone.
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Sustain.label: ioun skull stone: sustenance
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Sustain.description: The ioun stones that orbit the head in the original game are set into the frontal bone here. Hunger rate ×0.2. Each takes 1 attunement slot, up to 3 set in the frontal bone; removal returns the stone.
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Regen.label: ioun skull stone: regeneration
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Regen.description: The ioun stones that orbit the head in the original game are set into the frontal bone here. Heals one extra wound per day (the worst one; old scars don't count). Each takes 1 attunement slot, up to 3 set in the frontal bone; removal returns the stone.
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Mastery.label: ioun skull stone: mastery
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Mastery.description: The ioun stones that orbit the head in the original game are set into the frontal bone here. Proficiency bonus +1 (class power and checks use the new proficiency bonus). Each takes 1 attunement slot, up to 3 set in the frontal bone; removal returns the stone.
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Absorb.label: ioun skull stone: absorption
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Absorb.description: The ioun stones that orbit the head in the original game are set into the frontal bone here. Negates one instance of psychic or spell damage per day (weaponless fire, cold, lightning, psychic, arcane force damage). Each takes 1 attunement slot, up to 3 set in the frontal bone; removal returns the stone.
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Alert.label: ioun skull stone: awareness
LanguageData.LP_Ioun_Alert.description: The ioun stones that orbit the head in the original game are set into the frontal bone here. Can't be ambushed (sneak attack bonuses from assassins and hide in plain sight don't work on you), consciousness +5%. Each takes 1 attunement slot, up to 3 set in the frontal bone; removal returns the stone.
LanguageData.LP_Infused.label: infused
LanguageData.LP_Infused.description: An artificer has infused this prosthetic with magic: efficiency +10% (paired parts count half toward the corresponding capacity). Disappears when the prosthetic is removed.
LanguageData.LP_ArtificerTuned.label: artificer tuning
LanguageData.LP_ArtificerTuned.description: An artificer personally tunes the DND prosthetics on their own body: +3% efficiency per 4 artificer levels (up to +15%; paired parts count half toward the corresponding capacity).
LanguageData.LP_Flesh_HellHeart.label: netherfire heart
LanguageData.LP_Flesh_HellHeart.description: Netherfire replaces the heartbeat in the chest. Replaces the heart, part efficiency 120%; bleeding rate ×0.2. Grown at the necromantic ritual table from 800 raw meat and 150 silver; can be installed in liches and the living, and stacks with limb reinforcement. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_Flesh_BoneCage.label: bone rib cage
LanguageData.LP_Flesh_BoneCage.description: Grow another bone cage outside the ribs. Torso add-on, doesn't replace a part: torso max health +50%, sharp damage taken -20%. Grown at the necromantic ritual table from 600 raw meat and 150 silver; can be installed in liches and the living, and stacks with limb reinforcement. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_Flesh_DeadEar.label: ear of the dead's whispers
LanguageData.LP_Flesh_DeadEar.description: An ear that can hear the dead speak. Replaces one ear, part efficiency 125%; ability "Speak with dead": use on a humanlike corpse to learn 10% of the total XP of its highest skill (once per corpse; converted to adventurer XP as usual). Grown at the necromantic ritual table from 400 raw meat and 150 silver; can be installed in liches and the living, and stacks with limb reinforcement. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_Flesh_SoulJaw.label: soul-devouring jaw
LanguageData.LP_Flesh_SoulJaw.description: A jaw full of sharp teeth. Replaces the jaw, part efficiency 120%; adds a melee bite (14 damage); biting a living fleshy creature to death with it restores 10% psyfocus. Grown at the necromantic ritual table from 600 raw meat and 150 silver; can be installed in liches and the living, and stacks with limb reinforcement. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot.
LanguageData.LP_GraftTrollStalled.label: regeneration halted
LanguageData.LP_GraftTrollStalled.description: Fire or acid has damaged the troll regeneration gland: for 12 hours natural healing is back to normal speed and parts don't regrow.
LanguageData.LP_Graft_BeholderEye.label: beholder eye
LanguageData.LP_Graft_BeholderEye.description: An eye taken from a beholder, still rolling when grafted into a socket. Replaces one eye, part efficiency 110%; ability "Beholder ray" (20 cells, cooldown 1 day): randomly set on installation to necrotic ray (30 necrotic damage), petrification ray (begins petrification) or charm ray (dazed 25 seconds). Side effects: own mood -5 (aberrant gaze), others' opinion of you -10. Rare tier, takes 1 attunement slot. Grafts can only be sustained by living flesh; installed in a lich they necrotize within 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_Graft_DemonArm.label: demon arm
LanguageData.LP_Graft_DemonArm.description: An arm grown steeped in demon blood, with firelight under the skin. Replaces a whole arm, part efficiency 130%; melee hits add 5 fire damage. Side effects: 1% chance per day of a berserk rage break; can't be installed in celestial bloodlines (aasimar, celestial pact races). Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot. Grafts can only be sustained by living flesh; installed in a lich they necrotize within 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_Graft_TrollGland.label: troll regeneration gland
LanguageData.LP_Graft_TrollGland.description: A troll's regeneration gland, sewn onto the torso. Torso add-on: natural wound healing ×3; regrows one missing small part every 15 days. Side effects: hunger rate +50%; regeneration stops for 12 hours after taking fire or acid damage. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot. Grafts can only be sustained by living flesh; installed in a lich they necrotize within 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_Graft_ScaleRed.label: red dragonscale subdermal armor
LanguageData.LP_Graft_ScaleRed.description: Red dragon scales embedded under the skin. Torso add-on: sharp armor +15%, fire damage -50%, cold damage +20%. Only one dragonscale subdermal armor at a time. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot. Grafts can only be sustained by living flesh; installed in a lich they necrotize within 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_Graft_ScaleWhite.label: white dragonscale subdermal armor
LanguageData.LP_Graft_ScaleWhite.description: White dragon scales embedded under the skin. Torso add-on: sharp armor +15%, cold damage -50%, fire damage +20%. Only one dragonscale subdermal armor at a time. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot. Grafts can only be sustained by living flesh; installed in a lich they necrotize within 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_Graft_ScaleBlue.label: blue dragonscale subdermal armor
LanguageData.LP_Graft_ScaleBlue.description: Blue dragon scales embedded under the skin. Torso add-on: sharp armor +15%, lightning damage -50%, acid damage +20%. Only one dragonscale subdermal armor at a time. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot. Grafts can only be sustained by living flesh; installed in a lich they necrotize within 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_Graft_ScaleBlack.label: black dragonscale subdermal armor
LanguageData.LP_Graft_ScaleBlack.description: Black dragon scales embedded under the skin. Torso add-on: sharp armor +15%, acid damage -50%, lightning damage +20%. LanguageData.LP_Graft_ScaleGreen.label: green dragonscale subdermal armor
LanguageData.LP_Graft_ScaleGreen.description: Green dragon scales embedded under the skin. Torso add-on: sharp armor +15%, poison damage -50%, fire damage +20%. Only one dragonscale subdermal armor at a time. Common tier, doesn't take an attunement slot. Grafts can only be sustained by living flesh; installed in a lich they necrotize within 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_Graft_BreathRed.label: red dragon breath gland
LanguageData.LP_Graft_BreathRed.description: A breath gland cut from a red dragon's heart, sewn into the neck. Neck add-on: ability "Dragon breath" (6-cell cone, enemies take 30 fire damage, cooldown 1 day). Side effect: always spitting embers, others' opinion of you -5. Only one breath gland at a time. Rare tier, takes 1 attunement slot. Grafts can only be sustained by living flesh; installed in a lich they necrotize within 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_Graft_BreathWhite.label: white dragon breath gland
LanguageData.LP_Graft_BreathWhite.description: A breath gland cut from a white dragon's heart, sewn into the neck. Neck add-on: ability "Dragon breath" (6-cell cone, enemies take 30 cold damage, cooldown 1 day). Side effect: always spitting embers, others' opinion of you -5. Only one breath gland at a time. Rare tier, takes 1 attunement slot. Grafts can only be sustained by living flesh; installed in a lich they necrotize within 3 days.

LanguageData.LP_Graft_BreathBlue.description: A breath gland cut from a blue dragon's heart, sewn into the neck. Rare tier, takes 1 attunement slot. Grafts can only be sustained by living flesh; installed in a lich they necrotize within 3 days.

LanguageData.LP_Graft_BreathBlack.description: A breath gland cut from a black dragon's heart, sewn into the neck. LanguageData.LP_Graft_BreathGreen.label: green dragon breath gland
LanguageData.LP_Graft_BreathGreen.description: A breath gland cut from a green dragon's heart, sewn into the neck. Rare tier, takes 1 attunement slot. Grafts can only be sustained by living flesh; installed in a lich they necrotize within 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_Vecna_Hand.label: Hand of Vecna
LanguageData.LP_Vecna_Hand.description: The left hand of the lich-god Vecna, cut off by his betrayer, withered and black yet still moving. Replaces the left hand (your own left hand must be amputated first), part efficiency 150%; adventurer Strength at least 20; abilities "Frost touch" (touch, 30 cold damage and lowers temperature, cooldown 10 seconds) and "Command undead" (one enemy undead within 20 cells fights for you for 30 seconds, cooldown 1 day). Curse: every 60 days a 10% chance of an "evil will" murderous rage (halved for liches). Artifact tier, takes 1 attunement slot; can't stack with lich limb reinforcement. Removing it drops the artifact on the ground, and the host gets mood -15 for 30 days. When both pieces are installed in the same person, "Will of Vecna" triggers: command capacity +50%, and for a lich with an undead body, phylactery revival shortens from 3 days to 1, but Kas the Betrayer comes calling with the Sword of Kas (first after 3-7 days, then every 30 days). Only one of each exists in the world: very rarely given by legendary adventure board commissions and mythal guardians past floor 60.
LanguageData.LP_Vecna_Eye.label: Eye of Vecna
LanguageData.LP_Vecna_Eye.description: Vecna's gouged-out left eye, like a dark red gem. Replaces the left eye, part efficiency 150%; sees normally in darkness (no light penalty); ability "Dominate person" (like a mind flayer's domination: only attacks its former companions for 30 seconds, cooldown 1 day). Curse: own mood -8 (Vecna's gaze), others' opinion of you -20. Artifact tier, takes 1 attunement slot; can't stack with lich limb reinforcement. Removing it drops the artifact on the ground, and the host gets mood -15 for 30 days. When both pieces are installed in the same person, "Will of Vecna" triggers: command capacity +50%, and for a lich with an undead body, phylactery revival shortens from 3 days to 1, but Kas the Betrayer comes calling with the Sword of Kas (first after 3-7 days, then every 30 days). Only one of each exists in the world: very rarely given by legendary adventure board commissions and mythal guardians past floor 60.
LanguageData.LP_KasBlood.label: vampire body
LanguageData.LP_KasBlood.description: Kas has long been a vampire: damage taken -50%, melee damage +50%, wound healing ×5.
